dedupe_keys.name: sirent singapore satellite positioning reference network singapore land authority

description: SiReNT, the Singapore Satellite Positioning Reference Network of the Singapore Land Authority, provides differential GNSS correction data covering mainland Singapore and the offshore islands. Its reference stations page lists the stations with a sensor map, and one station (SING) serves as the integrity monitoring reference for the network while the others are open for users to connect. Services are by online subscription through a CorpPass or SingPass login: a one-time admin fee of S$32.10, post-processing on demand at S$10.70 per account plus S$0.32 per minute, monthly real-time kinematic and DGNSS accounts in tiers from S$107 down to S$32.10 per account, and a post-processing archive at S$53.50 per month, with a 3-day trial each month. Archived RINEX data more than one year old, stored in hourly files at 1-second intervals, can be purchased at S$53.50 per month and is delivered on disc. Use is under the general and service-specific terms and conditions of SiReNT; no open licence is stated. Caveats: the data is paid and needs a Singapore login, and the pages read differ on the station count (nine listed, plus SING). Coverage is Singapore. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and space weather effects on GNSS near the magnetic equator; related records are the Hong Kong SatRef network and the MYSA space weather services.
